genericProblem: A contract-face gate reuses a denominator owned by a different closure and hardcodes historical values, so an accepted catalog/report or generated projection can drift while the gate reports the wrong failure.
finiteDenominator: scripts/generate/edge-codegen.mjs current overlays and error-code closure
searchedSurfaces: edge codegen overlay and error closure
searchQueries: 106 active error codes versus operation closure

counterexamples.finding: 106 is the active error-code closure and must remain owned by the error-code gate, not operation-face validation.
147 operations (43/89/15) is a post-overlay projection and is not the U01 base placement report denominator.

findings.confirmedRootCause: The gate hardcodes 106 and 39/56/11, conflating the error-code closure with the U01 operation-face closure.
The accepted base catalog/report is 114 and 43/56/15; R24 and P3-C overlays intentionally project 147 and 43/89/15 for generated consumers.

The controller now resolves command targets through WorkspaceUserService.resolveCommandTarget, but the focused test still stubs the retired resolveTaskScope method, so Mockito returns null and the test dereferences it.

The optional-filter page test hardcodes a total of one even though @BeforeAll shares a database across tests that create additional administrators, making the assertion depend on test execution order.
